about.title: About

about.bio: Always Navigating Freedom, Inspiring Our Oceans.

start.title: Start
start.description: The template's landing page: pick a page from the sidebar or start with one of the shortcuts.

localTerminal.title: Terminal
localTerminal.description: Open a Windows command line inside the app and run interactive commands against it.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Keep each meeting, task or idea as a Markdown file: a file tree, a tabbed editor and a preview, written straight to the notes folder in the data directory.

filePreview.title: File Preview
filePreview.description: A read-only preview of the files under the project root: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, images, archives, audio and video are all parsed here, the file tree loads one level at a time, and nothing is written back to disk.

project.title: Project
project.description: Open the root configured in Settings → Project with the same editor the notes page mounts: directories load one level at a time, and files can be edited and written back to disk.

windowMenu.copyFailed: Failed to copy to the clipboard.

updater.cancelFailed: Failed to cancel the update download.
updater.disabledInDev: Update checks are not available in dev mode.

project.title: Project
project.description: The directory the file browser and the preview open at.
project.rootHint: Both the file browser and the preview serve this directory. Leave it blank to browse nothing until a project is chosen.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Customize the appearance and language of the app
appearance.presetFontsHint: Themes bring their own fonts, downloaded on first use and cached locally.

shortcut.title: Shortcuts
shortcut.showMainDesc: Use shortcut to quickly show the main window

data.title: Data
data.description: Choose where the app keeps its data — the config file, caches and assets it builds up. Everything else in the app reads this directory.
data.loadFailed: Failed to load the data directory settings.
data.dirHint: An absolute path. The directory is used as-is: if it is empty, everything starts from defaults, and nothing is copied over. Takes effect after a restart.
data.saved: Data directory saved. Restart to apply.
data.saveFailed: Failed to set the data directory.
data.pendingTitle: Restart to use the new data directory
data.currentHint: Where the app is reading and writing right now.
data.pointerNote: The data directory is recorded in this file. You can also edit it by hand.

notes.loadFailed: Could not load notes. Check that the data directory is readable.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Shared appearance for every code editor in the app, such as the notes page. Light and dark modes each keep their own theme, swapped automatically when the mode changes.
editor.lightThemeHint: Palette the editor uses while the app is in light mode.
editor.darkThemeHint: Palette the editor uses while the app is in dark mode.
editor.fontFamilyHint: Font for the editor text. Type to search installed fonts; leave blank for the built-in monospace stack.
editor.lineHeightHint: Multiple of the font size — 1.5 means 1.5×.
editor.lineNumbersHint: Show the line-number gutter beside the text.
editor.extensionsViewHint: Add an “Extensions” view to the activity bar beside the file tree and search — lists the running extensions and lets you stop or start each one. Next opening of the editor applies it.

projectPage.openFailed: Could not open the project. Check the project root in Settings → Project.
projectPage.notConfiguredHint: Set the project root in Settings → Project; the file browser and the preview open it.

filePreview.title: File preview
filePreview.treeEmpty: The project has no files to preview.
filePreview.treeFailed: Could not read the project files. Check the project root in Settings → Project.
filePreview.empty: Pick a file on the left to preview it.
filePreview.tooLarge: The file is too large to preview.
